Jordan / Ben —

Thanks for the context. My high-level guidance: we should aim to keep the MSA language consistent but allow Order Form-level sequencing that clarifies evidence packaging and the notice timeline where needed. Key recommendations below — these are redline-ready bullets we can convert to docx: 

1) Notice window: Accept 45 days as a negotiated Order Form exception only if we add (a) a requirement that the initial notice include a signed attestation (template below), and (b) a preservation SLA that requires the customer to snapshot and provide the first export within 7 days of notice and an S3 manifest within 14 days. That offsets the longer notice window operationally.

2) Evidence types: required items to accept a claim:
- JSON request logs (full request + metadata)
- Sample prompt sets and representative input examples
- Model output sample (text) with generation metadata (temperature, model version)
- KV cache snapshot manifest (if relevant) + hash of stored artifact
- Signed engineer attestation confirming authenticity and chain-of-custody (see template)

3) Attestation template (plain language):
"I, [name], in my capacity as [title] at [Customer], confirm that the enclosed artifacts are complete and were collected and preserved in accordance with our internal preservation procedures. I understand these artifacts will be used to evaluate a third-party IP claim."

4) Defense-control vs. step-in: We should keep MSA default of Redwood defense with notice and cooperation obligations but allow Order Form checkbox to permit customer step-in only where customer pays costs and provides counsel that meets our conflict rules. If Asteria insists on step-in as a default, increase cap or require escrow.

5) Acceptance criteria & timelines: Legal review will only consider evidence 'actionable' if the manifest and attestation are present; otherwise Redwood reserves the right to request further preservation and extend timelines. We should add language that allows reasonable technical follow-up (up to 30 days) to reproduce the issue.

6) Escrow / remediation fallback: If defense-control cannot be reached in 10 business days, the parties agree to an expedited mediation step and interim protections for both sides.

I ran quick redlines and attached a docx with suggested Order Form wording (redline_suggestions_kp_20270512.docx). Happy to hop on a 30-min call with Asteria counsel to walk through implications.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
